gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8439 covers machinery for making or finishing paper and parts thereof
Section XVI note 2(b): parts suitable solely or principally for a particular machine are classified with that machine's heading (8439)
GRI 6: 8439.99 parts, other, of machinery for making paper or paperboard
